summary: Second G2 correction after independent review rejected the first recovery's flat Tanium geometry. All eight primary paths use deterministic Tier-0 exterior traces rather than padded halos. Tanium now has three genuinely sloped wedge volumes, a recessed zigzag trench with floor and retaining walls, and an updated simple exterior path containing those volumes. Vendy retains its recessed dock; Kaizen Metrics retains pitched sawtooth roofs and a faceted lightwell; CableCar and XSearch retain tapered shells; T-Match retains alternating interlocking step plans and a recessed zigzag seam. This author report does not claim independent visual acceptance.
